standard_prerequisites.name: Colimits of sheaves of modules over a directed preordered set, and the description of the colimit through its sections

standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the system whose colimit is the given module.

standard_prerequisites.name: Local generation of a module of finite type by finitely many sections, and the lifting of a section of the colimit to a stage of the system
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 1159-1165
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces finitely many sections of the colimit and indices at which they appear.

core_obligations: Lift the generators: at a point of the space the proof chooses a neighbourhood and finitely many sections generating the colimit there, and shrinks the neighbourhood so that each of these sections comes from a stage of the system (proof lines 1159-1165)

Pass to a finite cover: quasi-compactness allows the proof to select finitely many such neighbourhoods covering the space, each with a stage and finitely many sections generating the colimit on it (proof lines 1166-1170)

Choose a common index: any index above all the finitely many stages reached has the property that the map from it to the colimit is surjective, and if the transition maps are injective the equality of the module with that stage follows (proof lines 1170-1171)
proof_roadmap: 对 x ∈ X 取邻域 U 与生成 colim F_i 的有限个截面 s_j，缩小 U 后可设每个 s_j 来自某一阶段 i。
由 X 准紧，取有限个这样的 U_j 覆盖 X，各配阶段 i_j 与生成截面；任何 ≥ 所有 i_j 的指标 i 都使 F_i → F 满；若转移映射单则更有 F = F_i。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a module of finite type on a quasi-compact ringed space which is the colimit of a directed system of modules is already the image of some stage, and is equal to some stage when the transition maps are injective (author lemma at source lines 1143-1156, label lemma-finite-type-quasi-compact-colimit). The proof (source lines 1158-1172) lifts finitely many local generators of the colimit to stages of the system, uses quasi-compactness to pass to a finite covering, and then takes an index above all the stages reached (proof lines 1159-1171). The combination of local lifting with quasi-compactness is the content. H2.
